title: K15 + L20 dexterous PCB transfer (MuJoCo)
scope: simulation-only scoring in the default layout; no real material calibration; real_transfer_count=0; grid worlds use nominal mass

finger_force_scale.meaning: finger kp = 4*scale N*m/rad, torque limit = 1.2*scale N*m

mass_kg.note: grid runs fix mass at nominal; posterior/prior masses below are marginalised over mass

binning: nearest grid value per axis (bin edges = midpoints between grid values, outer bins open-ended, samples beyond the grid extent fall into the edge bin; see mass_outside_grid_extent)
matrix_layout: mass[i_mu][i_f] with i_mu over axes.mu.values and i_f over axes.finger_force_scale.values

default.desc: default grasp and speed (episodes/default_g3 settings for PCB; ck_apple_transfer.DEF for apple)

stress.name: weak_fast
stress.provenance: humanoid_dex/compare_v2/stress_probe.json (chosen on cal split; executed on query in compare_v2/exec_weak_fast)

video.codec: H.264 High yuv420p, +faststart, no audio, no overlay text
video.renderer: MuJoCo 3.3.7 OSMesa, state replay of saved states.npz (no re-simulation); saved states (100/3 Hz) linearly resampled onto the 30 fps clock exactly as humanoid_dex/code/y_render.py

fail_type_rules.no_lift: PCB/apple height at end of lift-hold below the task lift gate (PCB 50 mm, apple 70 mm) and never above 20 mm
fail_type_rules.slipped_during_lift: lifted above 20 mm but below the lift gate at the end of lift-hold (slipped/fell during lift)
fail_type_rules.dropped: passed the lift gate but ended far from the target (PCB dz<-10 mm or planar >20 mm; apple planar >=50 mm)
fail_type_rules.unplanned_contact: placed within tolerance but hand/arm hit fixture/table/pads beyond the task contact gate (>10 N or >25 control steps)
fail_type_rules.place_offset_or_tilt: PCB final planar >=5 mm, |dz|>=3 mm or tilt >=5 deg
fail_type_rules.unstable_after_release: drift >=1 mm in the final 1 s

posterior.note: each query world has its own posterior conditioned on its simulated observation; there is no single posterior. featured = worlds chosen for the page; per_query_world = all 32; pooled = mixture over all 32 query posteriors (not a posterior of any one observation).

featured.why: stress action fails in the true world; posterior predicts the failure (posterior 0/8 vs prior 29/32 draws pass)
contrast: high friction / strong grip world, both actions pass

third_person.camera: exo: simulated third-person camera (pose fitted to the EXO phone view in humanoid_dex; virtual for the apple scene)
third_person.masking: none (K15 not masked per user rule; MuJoCo meshes are untextured, no brand text present)

selections.why: lowest-friction world that still passes the stress action; the f=0.20 neighbour fails
stress action: PCB lifted 93 mm then slips out during fast carry
